summary: 共用原型：任何有背景匿名驗證的訪客都可管理任一工作區，這是明確授權，不是私人帳號。Rules 預設拒絕未知路徑並驗證文件外層；深層商業規則仍在前端。

findings.issue: Rules bound the state arrays but do not validate every nested player, team and match. A visitor who bypasses the website can corrupt shared nested state. Client validation cannot prevent this.
findings.recommendation: For hostile public use, normalize nested entities into individually validated documents, or adopt a trusted backend after explicitly revisiting the free-only requirement.

verifiedControls: Anonymous authentication required for all data access
All authenticated visitors intentionally share management access
Strict top-level fields, required fields, types and array sizes on create and update
Server timestamps and immutable game metadata
Revision increments on whole-game, roster and score changes
Transaction conflict retries preserve scores on different matches
No physical profile or game deletes; archive is irreversible in client rules
No orphan subcollection access or arbitrary settings paths
Share creation is atomic with its active hash; expiry is at most 24 hours
Share tokens are never stored; hashes cannot be listed; expired and revoked links fail
